messages:
auditor_lee: Hi team - need SOC2/ISO evidence for private inference enclave (VPC + KMS) over last 12 months: RBAC change history, KMS Decrypt/GenerateDataKey logs, key rotation proof, and incident correlations. ETA?

carla(sec): We can supply: (1) RBAC change CSV from k8s + IAM snapshots, (2) CloudTrail extracts filtered for KMS Decrypt/GenerateDataKey, (3) KMS DescribeKey rotation statuses and rotation logs, (4) incident correlation table linking RBAC changes to IR tickets.

marta(devops): Auditor: full 12 months preferred? Sampling with exact criteria + full incident windows ok.

auditor_lee: Full 12 months preferred. If sampling, must include methodology and full windows for incidents.

rahul(dev): k8s audit example query: 
```
index=k8s_audit "RoleBinding" OR "ClusterRoleBinding" | fields user, verb, objectRef.name, @timestamp
```
I'll produce CSV with before/after state where available.

ops_tess: KMS pipeline: CloudTrail -> S3. Athena snippet to pull Decrypts: 
```sql
SELECT eventTime, userIdentity.arn, eventName, requestParameters.keyId FROM cloudtrail_logs WHERE eventName IN ('Decrypt','GenerateDataKey') AND eventTime >= '2025-03-01';
```
We will export gzipped CSVs.

carla(sec): Include STS AssumeRole joins so auditor can see temporary creds leading to KMS ops. Also detection narrative: how we alert on unauthorized bindings.

marta(devops): I'll own exports (RBAC + KMS). Rahul owns incident timelines. Carla owns control mapping doc. Tess please provision secure presigned S3 share.

ops_tess: Will create presigned share (14d expiry) and include signed export manifest with SHA256 checksums + exporter attestation. ETA for full bundle ~5 business days.

auditor_lee: 5 days works. Chain-of-custody requirement: include manifest, checksums, exporter username, timestamp, and S3 object versions.

rahul(dev): Example incident: IR-2025-211 had role escalation then suspicious Decrypt 2h later; will include timeline snippet and sanitized logs.

carla(sec): We'll redact PII/customer IDs and keep a redaction log. Also include key rotation proof and who could schedule rotations (IAM snapshot).

marta(devops): Starting exports tomorrow, will post progress.

evidence_bot: export queued id=exp-3456 owner=marta ETA=24h (automated).

auditor_lee: Thanks - please @me when the secure share is ready.
